body.description: Tumblet: a tumbleweed creature taken over by a strange signal, a ball of dry tangled brush around a rusty baling-wire skeleton, two faint green glowing eyes deep inside, rolling, drifting; a plant creature, not a machine. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
